title: Klarna automated the volume, not the trust

scenes.vo: Klarna said its AI was doing the work of seven hundred agents.
scenes.visual: Oversized editorial type on charcoal; the number is the only lime element.
scenes.animation: Lines rise out of clipping masks; slow push in.
scenes.sound: Score starts on the first frame, pulse and pluck.

scenes.vo: Fifteen months later, its CEO said Klarna would invest in human support again.
scenes.visual: Same typographic system, the contradiction stated plainly.
scenes.animation: Wipe up from the previous scene, mask reveals.

scenes.vo: The results were real. Two point three million chats in the first month.

data.label: in its first month. *Two thirds* of all customer service chats.

scenes.visual: One number, counted up so it lands on the spoken word.
scenes.animation: Count up with a settle, lime underline sweeps under it.
scenes.sound: Soft tick as the number lands.

scenes.vo: Errands went from eleven minutes to under two.
scenes.visual: Cream editorial page, two bars on one honest scale.
scenes.animation: Bars grow on the spoken numbers.

scenes.vo: But in May 2025, the CEO admitted cost had dominated, and what you end up having is lower quality.

data.quote: What you end up having is lower quality.

scenes.visual: Evidence card: the exact quote, speaker and date. No imagery.
scenes.sound: Score drops to pad and pulse.

scenes.vo: Here's what the headlines missed. The AI never left. It still handled about two thirds of chats.

data.body: It still handled about two thirds of chats.

scenes.visual: The reframe, set as a magazine headline on cream.
scenes.animation: Mask reveals, supporting line fades in when spoken.

scenes.vo: Klarna split the work. AI takes the routine volume. Humans become the premium layer, what the CEO now calls the VIP treatment.
scenes.visual: One wire splits into two paths: the brand motif made literal.
scenes.animation: Each branch draws as it is named.

scenes.vo: So, automate the volume, not the trust. Measure quality, not just cost. And always leave a door to a human.

points:
Always leave a door
to a human.

scenes.visual: Three numbered rules, one per beat.
scenes.animation: Each rule rises as it is spoken.
scenes.sound: Full groove, then resolves into the brand signature.
